links.outcome: Reading grade level of original cancer patient-facing website content
links.effect: Mean readability of original content across 34 websites was equivalent to a university freshman level (grade 13±1.5), above the average US reading level.
links.quote: The mean readability level across the 34 websites was equivalent to a university freshman level (grade 13±1.5).

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-rewritten cancer content versus original, with accuracy and quality
links.effect: Readability fell from grade 13±1.5 to grade 9±0.8; F1 0.87, cosine similarity 0.915; DISCERN 28.5±5 with no significant difference from originals.
links.quote: However, after ChatGPT's intervention, the AI-generated outputs had a mean readability score equivalent to a high school freshman education level (grade 9±0.8).
